test.command: PATH=".venv-ag-tests/bin:$PATH" make test && if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=5; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust tests"; fi

typecheck.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo check --workspace; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping typecheck"; fi

lint.command: if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f rust-ag/Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; else echo "No Rust workspace yet; skipping Rust lint"; fi

blockingIssues.description: scripts/parity/run_matrix.py now uses shlex.split(cmd_str), which fixes quoted arguments but regresses existing unquoted escaped-regex scenarios by stripping backslashes and changing argv semantics.

appliedUpdates.description: Added shared command entries for parity edge-case and fixture/manifest verification workflows: parity_edge_cases_baseline, parity_validate_fixture_integrity, parity_build_fixture_manifest_verify, parity_build_scenario_manifest_verify, and edge_fixtures_setup_verify.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document scenario command-template escaping conventions for manifests (especially `{pattern}` placeholders and backslash-sensitive regex inputs), and document nested fixture `.git/` pitfalls during staging so workers avoid accidental submodule-like states.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The failing review for baseline-parity-argv-tokenization-fix ties regression risk to undocumented escaping assumptions, and edge-case fixture review observed nested `.git/` staging failures that required remediation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit tooling-feature workflow guidance (Python/script/manifests) and require edge-case regression coverage for argv/tokenization changes, since current wording is Rust-centric and does not sufficiently guard shell/regex escaping semantics.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for baseline-fixture-manifest-reproducibility-fix and baseline-parity-argv-tokenization-fix both reported procedure mismatch for non-Rust work and missed escaping-regression coverage.

rejectedObservations.observation: Duplicate services.yaml missing-command observations for fixture/manifest verification commands.
Edge-scenario integrity strictness suggestion (require specific expected IDs) is a code-quality enhancement but not needed for immediate shared-state guidance update in this scrutiny round.
